name: Guinevere
source:
"You seem fun. Why don't you play with me for a while? Heehee..."

Guinevere is a well-mannered lady with a refined background, though her true nature is a little more capricious and playful. She died under mysterious circumstances. Her polite composure will quickly drop if there's competition on the line. Treats others sort of like toys. Loves chickens.

[From [url=https://lovelandisle.itch.io/love-in-a-bottle]itch.io[/url]]
